text.p: Swissair AG said its board of directors had decided to transform the Swissair group into a holding structure, which will be proposed to shareholders on May 22, 1997.

Earlier this year Swissair introduced a new management structure and its legal structure will now conform with this earlier change, Swissair chairman Hannes Goetz said in remarks prepared for a news conference.
A first phase in the creation of a holding structure was initiated on March 1 and the second phase involves setting up a legal structure for the Swissair airline.
Swissair already created legally independent entities in three of its four divisions and is now doing the same with its airline.

The airline operations will be spun off into a subsidiary, while the parent company, Swissair AG, will be transformed into a pure holding company with the name SAIR AG. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
